goals: Verify the book deletion API returns expected status codes (200 or 404) under concurrent load
activities: Initialize test data by loading and expanding book titles to 200 items
Select a random book title from the prepared list
Send HTTP GET request to search for the book by title
Extract ISBN from the search response body
Verify ISBN exists in the response
Send HTTP DELETE request to remove the book by ISBN
Verify delete response status is 200 or 404
